globalResearchRules: Mineral classification: Exploration Results -> Mineral Resources (Inferred/Indicated/Measured) -> Mineral Reserves (Probable/Proved), only when source permits.
Petroleum classification: SPE-PRMS 2018 Reserves/Contingent/Prospective and 1P/2P/3P where reported.
Geological endowment is not automatically a mineral reserve; reserve requires applicable modifying factors.
Ore grade, saleable-product purity and recovery are distinct.
Annual production is not daily rate; rate is not capacity; capacity is not plant throughput.
Mine level is a modeled gameplay classification derived from evidence, not an invented fact.
Capacity may be simulated for long-horizon gameplay, but its authority is SCENARIO_SIMULATION_DATA.
Route hypotheses may be modeled, but exact infrastructure, distance and bottlenecks require site-specific evidence.
Country reserve and site reserve remain separate ledgers.
Warehouse, inventory, factory, and transport state are downstream operational graphs, not geological facts.

mineLevel.purpose: gameplay industrial scale tier, never a geological fact
mineLevel.rule: Tier requires evidence-weighted classification. Do not derive a tier from reserve size alone.

realWorldLayer: observed minimum viable capacity when documented
capacity.rule: Simulation capacity is allowed for gameplay longevity but remains SCENARIO_SIMULATION_DATA and never becomes site evidence.
capacity.massBalance: physical output <= available extractable material × recovery and cannot exceed active capacity and route/plant bottlenecks.

quality.rule: grade != purity != recovery; each requires its own unit, basis, year and source.
quality.commoditySpecificValues: Use the commodity research module rather than one universal quality field.

route.rule: A candidate transport mode is not an observed route. Promote route segments only after named infrastructure, endpoints, distance and/or capacity evidence.

lifecycle.rule: Geological resource persists independently of operational state; extractable inventory is the state variable that depletes.
